name: Thumbnail Agent
description: Internal thumbnail generator with brand-specific templates and fonts, script-based background generation, optional original-photo composition that keeps uploaded people unchanged, and PNG download.
person_reference_notes: The background is generated from the script, then the uploaded photo is composited into the thumbnail.
Opaque photos stay complete, including their original background. Transparent PNG cutouts retain their supplied transparency. The photo can still be sent to OpenAI for visual planning.
The original people, faces, hair, expressions, pose, and clothing stay unchanged; only proportional scaling and positioning are applied to fit the brand.
Script and extra-prompt requests change the background, not the uploaded people's appearance.
Use the existing server OpenAI API key for planning and background generation; no separate reference-edit model setting is needed.
For people-only placement, upload a transparent PNG cutout. Review photo placement, visibility, and supplied transparency.
security_notes: Do not share your personal OpenAI API key.
Each copied app should use its own OpenAI API key or a separate company-managed key.
Anyone with access to the hosted link can use the app unless they add their own access control.
usage_notes: Leverage Edu uses three headline lines, with the last highlighted turquoise; use MY JOURNEY TO | UNIVERSITY OF | SALFORD to choose the line breaks.
Optionally upload a photo to keep its original people, faces, hair, expressions, and clothing unchanged in a new background.
Review photo placement and supplied transparency when a person photo was supplied.
